preconditions: Use an isolated protected Kind lease, exact immutable images, signed model qualification authority and a private synthetic actor roster.
For the remaining cold measurements, use an available instance capable of loading the exact model from an unloaded state under the declared ten-session workload.

normal_steps.action: Use the current protected Main, Training and replay route over real workload mTLS.
normal_steps.expected: Owner-scoped successful operation and retry with foreign denial.
normal_steps.actual: Scope verified through actual synthetic actor MFA and role peers.

normal_steps.action: Run ten scoped protected browser reads and an exact Qwen component generation.
normal_steps.expected: Ten authorized assignments and exact fixed-control response with matching token accounting.
normal_steps.actual: Ten reads passed. Protected exact Qwen control returned HTTP 200 and fixed READY.

normal_steps.action: Run the fresh-authority workload at declared peak.
normal_steps.expected: Measure ten active protected sessions, two occupied slots and eight queued tasks with two completed drafts.
normal_steps.actual: Observed the exact peak before and after the actor reads. Both real Qwen jobs completed and produced their drafts.

adverse_steps.action: Stop the owned protected Core, then the same leased node.
adverse_steps.expected: Observe current dependency losses and retained signed public fallback.
adverse_steps.actual: Both fault cutoffs, typed private denies, scoped recovery and signed Static observed.

adverse_steps.action: Pause only the owned model connector then restore it.
adverse_steps.expected: Bounded typed HTTP 503s followed by the same exact warmed control.
adverse_steps.actual: Two empty HTTP 503s and exact warm HTTP 200 observed at the component boundary.

adverse_steps.action: Observe actual reservations and queued tasks on the declared combined topology.
adverse_steps.expected: Ten active sessions, two durable slots and eight unique queued tasks.
adverse_steps.actual: The fresh-authority candidate reached the exact workload and completed both jobs in one round. Repeated timing acceptance remains open.

adverse_steps.action: Observe bounded error at declared load and exercise manual delivery.
adverse_steps.expected: Retain both uncertain slots, suppress drafts and deliver the exact manual message once.
adverse_steps.actual: Both unknown slots remained unchanged and the participant saw exactly one human-authored message after an exact retry.

checks.name: protected-deployed-journey
checks.expected: Proof-bound Training capture and replay, exact retry, scoped Main operations.
checks.actual: Actual password and TOTP, participant write/read, trainer ownership and exact replay passed.

checks.name: protected-workload-and-cni
checks.expected: Actual signed workload mTLS and same-target live CNI controls.
checks.actual: Journal signature and nonce matched. Unadmitted access to eight live dependencies was denied.

checks.name: protected-core-and-node-outage
checks.expected: Execute and restore the same isolated node and protected Core.
checks.actual: Both faults blocked protected Core. Same node and signed Journal recovered.

checks.name: independent-private-help-and-static
checks.expected: Bind actual Help authority and preserve signed Static during node loss.
checks.actual: Core-only loss preserved scoped Help. During the node outage, four operations returned typed 503 and the spool and audit were unchanged.

checks.name: pdp-init-idempotence
checks.expected: Exact owner-restricted OPA restarts on its existing sandbox file.
checks.actual: Verified and reused executable bytes in two consecutive invocations.

checks.name: initial-locked-source-regression
checks.expected: All locked commands in the current checkout.
checks.actual: 38 of 39 commands passed. 1,801 backend and 234 frontend tests passed. One local policy sample measured p95 53.173 ms.

checks.name: locked-source-latency-isolated-rerun
checks.expected: Unchanged 50 ms p95 threshold.
checks.actual: The isolated case passed at p95 43.567 ms.

checks.name: repeated-live-loopback
checks.expected: Actual local Qwen and 10/2/8 pressure with safe errors.
checks.actual: Three sequential repeated warm and compute-unknown error loops passed in the static loopback fixture.

checks.name: protected-assisted-route-controls
checks.expected: Real workload peers reach only the declared protected input boundaries.
checks.actual: Runtime reached the Core broker. Core to Inference and Inference to Data returned the expected HTTP 400 for empty requests. Ten live CNI dependencies rejected the unadmitted caller.

checks.name: current-release-custody
checks.expected: Five exact current evaluator boots acknowledge qualification-only authority.
checks.actual: Signed qualification acknowledgments were recorded for all five observed boots. A restrictive epoch was published when qualification ended.

checks.name: protected-browser-session-reads
checks.expected: Ten current protected browser sessions independently read their scoped synthetic assignment.
checks.actual: Ten scoped reads succeeded across five English and five French sessions at p95 429.764 ms. Active reads alone establish no concurrent manual delivery or model reservation.

checks.name: deployed-qwen-generation-control
checks.expected: The exact loaded Qwen model generates the fixed control over the protected Inference-to-host path.
checks.actual: HTTP 200 and exact READY in 24.039 s, with 27 SDK and provider prompt tokens and seven completion tokens.

checks.name: deployed-qwen-bounded-component-errors
checks.expected: The owned connector fails within bounds and the same loaded model recovers on that protected component path.
checks.actual: Two injected pauses returned empty HTTP 503 in 2.025 s and 2.043 s. The fixed warm control recovered in 2.504 s.

checks.name: deployed-warm-and-error-workload-distributions
checks.expected: Repeated warm and bounded-error timings with ten active sessions, two occupied slots and eight queued tasks on the exact deployed topology.
checks.actual: The repair produced one full-load warm success with two durable completed jobs and one distinct full-load round with two safe compute-unknown outcomes. Repeated distributions remain incomplete.

checks.name: deployed-cold-workload-distribution
checks.expected: Repeat true cold starts with the exact Qwen model and declared deployed ten-session load.
checks.actual: Zero cold cycles. The current model must stay loaded. The 36 GiB host rejected a second instance under its resource guardrails, and there is no separate machine.

checks.name: quiet-locked-source-regression
checks.expected: Repeat all locked checks after isolated cluster teardown.
checks.actual: 39 of 39 commands passed.

checks.name: qualification-teardown
checks.expected: Remove the dedicated test resources and preserve existing review environments and native model.
checks.actual: Owned resource and preservation checks are recorded in the cleanup receipt.

checks.name: broker-failure-typed-response
checks.expected: Core returns its typed denial and performs no retry on an unavailable Inference response.
checks.actual: Upstream 503, read timeout and invalid result each returned typed HTTP 503 in the composed route regression. The exact live worker retry received HTTP 503.

checks.name: fresh-job-scoped-actor-authority
checks.expected: A task proceeds under new operation-specific Identity proofs after its original proof expires.
checks.actual: The expiry-aware worker journey completed on TLS PostgreSQL and 134 focused tests passed.

checks.name: fresh-authority-deployed-worker
checks.expected: The exact deployed worker creates one durable result and unsent draft using the unchanged loaded model.
checks.actual: The real turn reached awaiting_human in 21.396 s, with one completed job, one draft and its compute slot free.

checks.name: fresh-authority-declared-warm-peak
checks.expected: The declared live workload reaches ten active sessions, two occupied slots and eight unique pending tasks before and after the protected reads.
checks.actual: Both jobs completed and produced one draft each in the first full-load round. The dispatch-to-terminal interval was 27.427 s.

checks.name: fresh-authority-declared-bounded-timeouts
checks.expected: A real full-load response failure produces no draft, retains uncertain compute and preserves durable records.
checks.actual: The separate full-load round returned HTTP 503 for both jobs after 28.601 s and 28.517 s at the host bridge. Both durable slots remained compute-unknown, with zero drafts.

checks.name: fresh-authority-manual-after-saturation
checks.expected: Manual actor delivery remains separate from inference with two unknown compute slots.
checks.actual: A protected human message was visible exactly once and the exact retry returned the same message, while both compute slots stayed unknown.

checks.name: fresh-authority-locked-source-regression
checks.expected: Verify all locked commands against the exact source after isolated cleanup.
checks.actual: 38 of 39 commands passed on the deployed candidate source. The workstation fixture used an earlier Identity reference; the separate post-lock checks record the corrected fixture.

checks.name: fresh-authority-post-lock-source-regression
checks.expected: Locked checks on the final source, including the corrected workstation fixture and authority-at-lock tests.
checks.actual: 39 of 39 locked checks passed. The dedicated TLS fixture passed both guarded lock cases in the focused suite.

residuals: Repeat true cold starts with the exact Qwen model at declared ten-session load. The current model must stay loaded, the workstation guardrails reject a second exact instance, and the user confirmed that no separate test machine is available.

Complete repeated deployed warm and error distributions for the final post-lock source at the exact ten-session load. The earlier deployed authority image completed both jobs in one declared-load warm round and preserved two uncertain slots after two HTTP 503 responses in another.
acceptance_scope: Private synthetic Kubernetes qualification with actor, workload trust, outage and standalone model controls. G-10 remains open.
rollback: Advance the temporary qualification registry to a restrictive epoch and remove the leased environment. Preserve the native model and saved review environments.
